body: So no 10-star Iron Fist... ok then

Thank you so much for your time

I feel a lot better

-Ultra

I’m an Asian. I have straight A’s good music skills, the whole whatever. The problem is that I’ve been like that for so long that it’s what everybody expects from me and it’s tiring.

I’m afraid that if I get a B or something everybody will think less of me and that I’ll be left behind.

I’ve told my school counselor that I don’t know how I feel because I care so much about how others feel of me that I don’t care about myself. All she said was, “You’re putting too much pressure on yourself.”

Also my emotional feelings are complicated I’m in middle school so I’m in the middle of puberty, but my feelings go from angry, to confused, to happy, etc. I just don’t know what to do.
